WITH borough_avg_precip AS (
  SELECT
    borough_id,
    AVG(precip_mm) AS avg_daily_precip
  FROM weather_daily
  GROUP BY borough_id
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_daily_precip) AS overall_avg_daily_precip
  FROM borough_avg_precip
),
selected_boroughs AS (
  SELECT b.borough_id
  FROM borough_avg_precip b
  CROSS JOIN overall_avg o
  WHERE b.avg_daily_precip > o.overall_avg_daily_precip
),
borough_top_techs AS (
  SELECT
    t.technician_id,
    t.hourly_rate_cents,
    t.depot_borough_id,
    MAX(t.hourly_rate_cents) OVER (PARTITION BY t.depot_borough_id) AS max_rate_in_borough
  FROM technicians t
  JOIN selected_boroughs sb
    ON sb.borough_id = t.depot_borough_id
),
leading_techs AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    technician_id,
    hourly_rate_cents
  FROM borough_top_techs
  WHERE hourly_rate_cents = max_rate_in_borough
)
SELECT
  1.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN hourly_rate_cents >= 2500 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS proportion
FROM leading_techs

WITH station_bike_history AS (
  SELECT
    m.station_id,
    m.bike_id
  FROM maintenance m
  WHERE m.station_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY m.station_id, m.bike_id
),
eligible_stations AS (
  SELECT station_id
  FROM station_bike_history
  GROUP BY station_id
  HAVING COUNT(*) >= 20
),
stations_with_current_in_maintenance_bike AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT sbh.station_id
  FROM station_bike_history sbh
  JOIN bikes b
    ON b.bike_id = sbh.bike_id
  WHERE b.status = 'maintenance'
)
SELECT
  100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT sw.station_id) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT es.station_id), 0) AS percentage
FROM eligible_stations es
LEFT JOIN stations_with_current_in_maintenance_bike sw
  ON sw.station_id = es.station_id

WITH borough_weather AS (
  SELECT
    b.borough_id,
    b.borough_name,
    b.population,
    b.area_km2,
    MAX(w.wind_kph) AS highest_daily_wind_speed,
    COUNT(w.day) AS weather_days,
    SUM(CASE WHEN w.precip_mm > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS precip_days,
    AVG(w.temp_c_avg) AS avg_temp_c,
    AVG(w.precip_mm) AS avg_precip_mm
  FROM boroughs b
  JOIN weather_daily w
    ON w.borough_id = b.borough_id
  GROUP BY b.borough_id, b.borough_name, b.population, b.area_km2
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    bw.*,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      ORDER BY bw.highest_daily_wind_speed DESC,
               bw.weather_days DESC,
               bw.borough_name ASC
    ) AS rn
  FROM borough_weather bw
),
tech_stats AS (
  SELECT
    s.borough_id,
    COUNT(t.technician_id) AS technician_count,
    AVG(t.hourly_rate_cents) AS avg_technician_hourly_rate_cents,
    MAX(t.hourly_rate_cents) AS max_technician_hourly_rate_cents,
    MIN(t.hired_on) AS earliest_technician_hire_date
  FROM stations s
  JOIN technicians t
    ON t.depot_borough_id = s.borough_id
  GROUP BY s.borough_id
)
SELECT
  r.borough_id,
  r.borough_name,
  r.highest_daily_wind_speed,
  r.weather_days,
  COALESCE(ts.technician_count, 0) AS technician_count,
  CAST(r.precip_days AS REAL) / NULLIF(r.weather_days, 0) AS share_weather_days_with_precipitation,
  r.avg_temp_c,
  r.avg_precip_mm,
  ts.avg_technician_hourly_rate_cents,
  ts.max_technician_hourly_rate_cents,
  (COALESCE(ts.technician_count, 0) * 100000.0) / NULLIF(r.population, 0) AS technicians_per_100k_residents,
  r.population / NULLIF(r.area_km2, 0) AS population_density,
  ts.earliest_technician_hire_date,
  CASE
    WHEN COALESCE(ts.technician_count, 0) = 0 THEN 'no_technicians'
    WHEN CAST(r.precip_days AS REAL) / NULLIF(r.weather_days, 0) >= 0.5 THEN 'rainy'
    WHEN r.avg_temp_c >= 20 THEN 'warm'
    ELSE 'mild'
  END AS borough_label
FROM ranked r
LEFT JOIN tech_stats ts
  ON ts.borough_id = r.borough_id
WHERE r.rn = 1

SELECT
  p.plan_name,
  CASE
    WHEN COALESCE(t.trip_count, 0) = 0 THEN 'no_trips'
    WHEN COALESCE(t.trip_count, 0) BETWEEN 1 AND 5 THEN 'light'
    WHEN COALESCE(t.trip_count, 0) BETWEEN 6 AND 20 THEN 'moderate'
    ELSE 'heavy'
  END AS activity_band,
  COUNT(*) AS member_count
FROM members m
JOIN plans p
  ON p.plan_id = m.plan_id
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT
    member_id,
    COUNT(*) AS trip_count
  FROM trips
  GROUP BY member_id
) t
  ON t.member_id = m.member_id
GROUP BY
  p.plan_name,
  activity_band
ORDER BY
  p.plan_name,
  activity_band

WITH borough_station_stats AS (
  SELECT
    b.borough_id,
    b.borough_name,
    COUNT(s.station_id) AS station_count,
    SUM(s.capacity) AS total_station_capacity
  FROM boroughs b
  JOIN stations s
    ON s.borough_id = b.borough_id
  GROUP BY b.borough_id, b.borough_name
),
borough_tech_stats AS (
  SELECT
    depot_borough_id AS borough_id,
    COUNT(*) AS technician_count
  FROM technicians
  GROUP BY depot_borough_id
)
SELECT
  bs.borough_id,
  bs.borough_name,
  bs.station_count,
  bs.total_station_capacity,
  COALESCE(bt.technician_count, 0) AS technician_count,
  SUM(bs.total_station_capacity) OVER (
    ORDER BY COALESCE(bt.technician_count, 0) ASC, bs.borough_name ASC
    ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
  ) AS running_total_station_capacity
FROM borough_station_stats bs
LEFT JOIN borough_tech_stats bt
  ON bt.borough_id = bs.borough_id
ORDER BY COALESCE(bt.technician_count, 0) ASC, bs.borough_name ASC

SELECT
  bm.model_id,
  bm.model_name,
  bm.is_electric,
  COUNT(m.job_id) AS total_maintenance_jobs,
  SUM(CASE WHEN m.completed_at IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS open_jobs,
  AVG(julianday(COALESCE(m.completed_at, DATE('now'))) - julianday(m.reported_at)) AS avg_days_per_reported_job,
  AVG(CASE WHEN m.completed_at IS NOT NULL THEN julianday(m.completed_at) - julianday(m.reported_at) END) AS avg_days_per_completed_job,
  AVG(julianday(COALESCE(m.completed_at, DATE('now'))) - julianday(m.reported_at))
    - AVG(CASE WHEN m.completed_at IS NOT NULL THEN julianday(m.completed_at) - julianday(m.reported_at) END) AS avg_difference
FROM bike_models bm
JOIN bikes b
  ON b.model_id = bm.model_id
JOIN maintenance m
  ON m.bike_id = b.bike_id
GROUP BY bm.model_id, bm.model_name, bm.is_electric
ORDER BY avg_difference DESC, total_maintenance_jobs DESC

WITH member_totals AS (
  SELECT
    m.member_id,
    m.joined_on,
    COUNT(t.trip_id) AS trip_count,
    SUM(t.distance_km) AS total_distance
  FROM members m
  JOIN trips t
    ON t.member_id = m.member_id
  GROUP BY m.member_id, m.joined_on
),
avg_total AS (
  SELECT AVG(total_distance) AS avg_distance
  FROM member_totals
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    mt.*,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      ORDER BY mt.total_distance DESC, mt.member_id
    ) AS dist_rank
  FROM member_totals mt
  CROSS JOIN avg_total a
  WHERE mt.total_distance > a.avg_distance
)
SELECT
  member_id,
  joined_on,
  trip_count,
  total_distance,
  SUM(total_distance) OVER (
    ORDER BY joined_on, member_id
    ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
  ) AS running_cumulative_total
FROM ranked
WHERE dist_rank <= 10
ORDER BY joined_on, member_id

WITH station_job_counts AS (
  SELECT
    s.station_id,
    s.station_name,
    COUNT(m.job_id) AS maintenance_job_count
  FROM stations s
  LEFT JOIN maintenance m
    ON m.station_id = s.station_id
  LEFT JOIN bikes b
    ON b.bike_id = m.bike_id
   AND b.status = 'in_service'
  WHERE s.is_active = 1
    AND (m.job_id IS NULL OR b.bike_id IS NOT NULL)
  GROUP BY s.station_id, s.station_name
),
avg_count AS (
  SELECT AVG(maintenance_job_count) AS overall_avg
  FROM station_job_counts
),
above_avg AS (
  SELECT sjc.*
  FROM station_job_counts sjc
  CROSS JOIN avg_count ac
  WHERE sjc.maintenance_job_count > ac.overall_avg
)
SELECT
  station_id,
  station_name,
  maintenance_job_count,
  (SELECT AVG(maintenance_job_count) FROM above_avg) AS avg_maintenance_job_count_above_average_group
FROM above_avg
ORDER BY maintenance_job_count DESC, station_name

WITH latest_weather AS (
  SELECT
    borough_id,
    MAX(day) AS latest_day
  FROM weather_daily
  GROUP BY borough_id
),
borough_weather_stats AS (
  SELECT
    wd.borough_id,
    SUM(wd.precip_mm) AS cumulative_precip_mm,
    AVG(wd.temp_c_avg) AS running_avg_temp_c,
    MAX(wd.wind_kph) AS max_wind_kph
  FROM weather_daily wd
  JOIN latest_weather lw
    ON lw.borough_id = wd.borough_id
   AND wd.day <= lw.latest_day
  GROUP BY wd.borough_id
),
latest_day_precip AS (
  SELECT
    wd.borough_id,
    wd.precip_mm,
    CASE
      WHEN wd.precip_mm >= 10 THEN 'very_wet'
      WHEN wd.precip_mm >= 2 THEN 'wet'
      ELSE 'dry'
    END AS precip_label
  FROM weather_daily wd
  JOIN latest_weather lw
    ON lw.borough_id = wd.borough_id
   AND wd.day = lw.latest_day
),
tech_counts AS (
  SELECT
    depot_borough_id AS borough_id,
    COUNT(*) AS technician_count,
    AVG(hourly_rate_cents) AS avg_hourly_rate_cents
  FROM technicians
  GROUP BY depot_borough_id
),
total_techs AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_technicians
  FROM technicians
)
SELECT
  b.borough_id,
  b.borough_name,
  lw.latest_day AS latest_weather_date,
  bws.cumulative_precip_mm,
  COALESCE(tc.technician_count, 0) AS technician_count,
  COALESCE(CAST(tc.technician_count AS REAL) / NULLIF(tt.total_technicians, 0), 0) AS technician_share,
  tc.avg_hourly_rate_cents,
  bws.running_avg_temp_c,
  bws.max_wind_kph,
  ldp.precip_label
FROM boroughs b
JOIN latest_weather lw
  ON lw.borough_id = b.borough_id
LEFT JOIN borough_weather_stats bws
  ON bws.borough_id = b.borough_id
LEFT JOIN latest_day_precip ldp
  ON ldp.borough_id = b.borough_id
LEFT JOIN tech_counts tc
  ON tc.borough_id = b.borough_id
CROSS JOIN total_techs tt
ORDER BY b.borough_name

WITH member_trip_stats AS (
  SELECT
    m.member_id,
    COUNT(t.trip_id) AS trip_count,
    COALESCE(AVG(t.distance_km), 0) AS avg_trip_distance
  FROM members m
  LEFT JOIN trips t
    ON t.member_id = m.member_id
  GROUP BY m.member_id
)
SELECT
  trip_count,
  AVG(avg_trip_distance) AS avg_of_members_avg_trip_distance_km,
  COUNT(*) AS member_count
FROM member_trip_stats
GROUP BY trip_count
ORDER BY trip_count ASC

WITH months AS (
  SELECT bike_id, substr(started_at, 1, 7) AS month
  FROM trips
  GROUP BY bike_id, substr(started_at, 1, 7)
  UNION
  SELECT bike_id, substr(reported_at, 1, 7) AS month
  FROM maintenance
  GROUP BY bike_id, substr(reported_at, 1, 7)
),
trip_counts AS (
  SELECT bike_id, substr(started_at, 1, 7) AS month, COUNT(*) AS trips_started
  FROM trips
  GROUP BY bike_id, substr(started_at, 1, 7)
),
maint_counts AS (
  SELECT bike_id, substr(reported_at, 1, 7) AS month, COUNT(*) AS maintenance_jobs_reported
  FROM maintenance
  GROUP BY bike_id, substr(reported_at, 1, 7)
),
monthly AS (
  SELECT
    m.bike_id,
    b.model_id,
    m.month,
    COALESCE(t.trips_started, 0) AS trips_started,
    COALESCE(mc.maintenance_jobs_reported, 0) AS maintenance_jobs_reported
  FROM months m
  JOIN bikes b ON b.bike_id = m.bike_id
  LEFT JOIN trip_counts t
    ON t.bike_id = m.bike_id AND t.month = m.month
  LEFT JOIN maint_counts mc
    ON mc.bike_id = m.bike_id AND mc.month = m.month
)
SELECT
  bike_id,
  model_id,
  month,
  trips_started,
  maintenance_jobs_reported,
  SUM(trips_started) OVER (
    PARTITION BY bike_id
    ORDER BY month
    ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
  ) AS cumulative_trips
FROM monthly
ORDER BY bike_id, month

SELECT
  bm.model_id,
  bm.model_name,
  bm.is_electric,
  COUNT(t.trip_id) AS total_trips,
  SUM(CASE WHEN t.ended_at IS NOT NULL AND t.end_station_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS completed_trips,
  ROUND(
    1.0 * COUNT(t.trip_id) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN t.ended_at IS NOT NULL AND t.end_station_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0),
    4
  ) AS trip_to_completed_ratio,
  CASE
    WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN t.ended_at IS NOT NULL AND t.end_station_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0
      THEN 'no_completed_trips'
    WHEN 1.0 * COUNT(t.trip_id) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN t.ended_at IS NOT NULL AND t.end_station_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) < 1.005
      THEN 'excellent_return_capture'
    WHEN 1.0 * COUNT(t.trip_id) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN t.ended_at IS NOT NULL AND t.end_station_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) < 1.02
      THEN 'good_return_capture'
    WHEN 1.0 * COUNT(t.trip_id) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN t.ended_at IS NOT NULL AND t.end_station_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) < 1.05
      THEN 'warning_return_gap'
    ELSE 'severe_return_gap'
  END AS return_gap_label
FROM bike_models bm
LEFT JOIN bikes b
  ON b.model_id = bm.model_id
LEFT JOIN trips t
  ON t.bike_id = b.bike_id
GROUP BY bm.model_id, bm.model_name, bm.is_electric
ORDER BY
  CASE
    WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN t.ended_at IS NOT NULL AND t.end_station_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0
      THEN -1
    ELSE 1.0 * COUNT(t.trip_id) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN t.ended_at IS NOT NULL AND t.end_station_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0)
  END DESC,
  bm.model_id
